# Late Venutai Chavan Multipurpose Hall

Late Venutai Chavan Multipurpose Hall is a banquet and event venue at Yashwantrao Chavan Smarak, Sector 27A, Pradhikaran, Nigdi, Pune 411044. The venue lists a Big Hall for up to 1,200 guests, a Small Hall for up to 350, a Dining Hall for 400 at a time, VIP A/C Dining for 50 at a time and up to eight A/C guest rooms. Listed hours are Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Listed facilities include air-conditioning, acoustic system, LED screen, projector, Wi-Fi, parking, CCTV, fire alarm, lift, lobby and catering support for your own caterer.

Phone contacts: Jadhav Kedar 9359567494; Jadhav Prashant 9834005348; Shinde Vikas 9527926303. Pricing is not published; contact the venue for a quote. An enquiry does not confirm a booking.
